management.impact.execution.other: Keep the current conversation and workspace while changing execution settings. History migrates if the runtime changes. You can continue using the conversation until preparation finishes.

management.impact.recovery.other: The original conversation and project directory are unavailable. Create a blank persistent conversation or bind an existing project again.

management.error.target.unavailable.other: The current conversation runtime target is unavailable. Try again later.

session.goal.empty.other: No goal is set. Send goal <objective> to start one.

session.goal.usage.other: goal <objective> · goal · goal pause|resume|clear · goal set <objective> · goal budget <tokens>

session.goal.no_binding.other: No session is bound here. Send goal <objective> to create a session and start a goal.

session.goal.unsupported.other: This runtime does not support native goals.

management.steer.foreground.description.other: Feishu thread/singleton chats act as the foreground: long work is delegated to background agents, and follow-ups sent mid-turn are injected into the running turn instead of interrupting it. Off by default.

management.steer.foreground.applies.live.other: Takes effect immediately on save; no restart needed (persists across restarts).

management.choose.whether.to.enable.stee.other: Choose whether to enable foreground/background split & mid-turn steering

management.show.background.tasks.descrip.other: When on, each background task (subtask / spawned agent instance) started from a Feishu chat gets its own live progress card. Off by default: background work stays out of the chat and the foreground agent reports results.

management.choose.whether.to.show.backgr.other: Choose whether to show background task progress cards
